{{Top|leg}}
Between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] built a '''bacteriological research outpost''' in [[Haxim's city|the capital city]] of [[Haxim's province|Haxim's kingdom]] on [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. In 7 BBY, a toxic [[flesh-eating bacterium]] escaped from the city, spreading quickly. The Empire decided to [[Bombardment of Falleen|bombard]] the city to contain the bacterium, destroying the research outpost.
